observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Open outdoor paved plaza or square lined with white tents and a large spectator crowd under a bright sky.
observation.dancers: Mixed group of men and women, appearing to be young adults or teenagers, performing together in a large line/group.
observation.formation_and_space: Initially two female dancers move forward, then a larger line of dancers enters and forms a curved line or semi-circle moving together across the open space.
observation.posture: Forward torso inclination from the hips with knees slightly bent and softened, weight centered over the balls of the feet.
observation.footwork: Rhythmic quick stepping, shuffling, and light stamping matching the rapid drum beat; exact weight placement on individual beats is occluded by camera distance and angle.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held loosely by the sides or extended outward for balance; some dancers hold drums or gourds strapped to their bodies while others swing arms rhythmically.
observation.hips_and_torso: Bouncing torso movement coordinated with knee flexion and foot rhythm, maintaining a forward bend.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Low level maintained through bent knees; no high jumps or complex floor work; occasional pivots and directional shifts.
observation.costume_and_props: Traditional-style performance attire: white sleeveless tops, decorative striped skirts or sashes with fringe and tassels (yellow, black, blue, white), and some participants carry or play gourd drums.
observation.cannot_infer: Precise foot-to-ground contact details, individual finger positions, and facial expressions are obscured due to wide camera angles and video resolution.

signature_moments.what: Two female dancers step forward in a slight forward lean with rapid foot shuffles and swinging fringe skirts.
A large line of male and female dancers crouch slightly while playing drums and stepping in unison across the square.
